recognize_zh: CD20 染色下整片小到中型淋巴樣細胞呈均勻一致的膜性陽性，排列緊密、形態單調，只夾雜少數陰性的小血管與組織細胞，確認為瀰漫性 B 細胞淋巴瘤（配合 cyclin D1 判讀為被套細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: Diffuse sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with uniform membranous CD20 positivity
Monotonous cell population without nodular variation in this field
Scattered negative spaces corresponding to small vessels and histiocytes
No residual germinal centers or T-cell zones apparent
describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows diffuse, uniform membranous positivity in a densely packed, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells. Only scattered negative foci corresponding to small vessels and histiocytes interrupt the infiltrate, and no residual follicles or T-cell zones are apparent. CD20 establishes B-cell lineage but is not specific for subtype. In conjunction with cyclin D1 and CD5 positivity, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows dim CD20, proliferation centers, and LEF1/CD23 positivity without cyclin D1.
FL cells are CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative, typically with CD21-positive dendritic meshworks.
MZL has monocytoid cells and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
